title: Company Alignment Constellation: Initiative Liftoff & Cross-Functional Playbook
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Deliver a repeatable 'Constellation' playbook to map company-level OKRs to cross-functional initiatives, visualize initiative dependencies as orbits, and provide a lightweight liftoff checklist for each initiative. The playbook should reduce kickoff ambiguity, speed decisioning at cross-team syncs, and improve traceability between OKRs, projects, and delivery milestones.
background: We observed repeated misalignment during initiative kickoffs: unclear owners, mismatched success metrics, and buried dependencies across infra, product, and design. Existing OKR artifacts are fragmented across decks and Confluence pages. The Constellation playbook will be the single source for initiative liftoff and alignment for company-level objectives.
goals: Create standard liftoff checklist across PM/Eng/Design/SRE
Ship a visual initiative mapping (Constellation) that links OKRs -> initiatives -> owners -> dependencies
Reduce cross-team kickoff questions by 50% in the next cycle
Enable automatic extraction of initiative status into the company OKR dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence with template and examples
Constellation visual (SVG + CSV) generated for at least 6 active company initiatives
Liftoff checklist included in every initiative creation flow and used by 3 pilot teams
Links from initiatives to PRs, runbooks, and dashboards are present for pilot initiatives
Stakeholder signoff from Eng, Design, Security, and GTM recorded in comments
deliverables: CSV schema for initiative exports and Constellation renderer
One-pager liftoff checklist integrated into Linear issue template
Pilot rollouts with 3 initiatives and retrospective notes
milestones: 2026-02-22: Internal review with Eng and Design
2026-03-20: Collect pilot feedback and finalize artifacts
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Teams ignore the new template due to perceived overhead -> Mitigation: keep liftoff checklist to 6 mandatory items and provide example filled templates
Risk: Dependencies are underreported -> Mitigation: add a mandatory dependency field on initiative creation and run an intake sweep with PMs
Risk: Visualization complexity for large initiatives -> Mitigation: implement filtering by objective and owner in the Constellation renderer
notes: Decision: Use 'orbits' to indicate dependency depth (0 = core, 1 = adjacent, 2 = external)
Trade-off: Auto-extraction from PRs would be ideal but is scoped out of MVP due to infra cost
Follow-up: Explore small ETL job to push Linear exports into the company OKR dashboard (see dependency ENG-72833)
comments: 2026-02-12 - Mariana Ortiz (Design): Reviewed draft visuals; suggested color-coding by objective rather than org to avoid clutter
2026-02-18 - Leo Park (Engineering): Confirmed feasibility of CSV schema and proposed adding a 'delivery_sla' field
2026-02-25 - Sophie Chen (Security): No security blockers; recommend adding link field for any customer data dependencies
2026-02-28 - Ben Liu (PM, assignee): Pilot initiatives selected: runtime-1.18 rollout, console-2026.02 dashboard revamp, dedicated-autoscaling policies
implementation_notes: ENG will provide a small exporter (weekly cron job) from Linear to generate the CSV for visualization. Design will supply an SVG renderer and a lightweight interactive HTML page for filtering. PMs will be responsible for filling the liftoff checklist at issue creation. A retro will be run after the pilot to measure the 50% kickoff questionnaire reduction target.
retro_plan: Collect feedback after 6 weeks from pilot teams, quantify reduction in clarification threads, and iterate on the checklist. Publish a 'lessons learned' section in the Confluence playbook.
next_steps: Finalize Confluence template based on design feedback
ENG to open exporter ticket and assign resource (ENG-72833)
Schedule pilot kickoff demos with the three initiative leads
Prepare a short training doc and video for PMs
